model_name: EIDT Calibrated Random Forest Flood Predictor
validation_split_strategy: Temporal Event-Level Holdout: Train on 2005-2019 events (N=50); Test on strictly held-out 2020-2023 events (N=50). Grouping by event ensures zero intra-event leakage.

probability_calibration_evaluation.notes: Brier score 0.1246 validates good probability calibration (closer to 0.0 indicates well-calibrated posterior probabilities).

event_group_cv.method: Leave-One-Event-Out Group Cross-Validation on Training Events

feature_importance.interpretation: Empirical model weight reflecting correlation with historical flood occurrences. Not a causal proof.

thresholds.rationale: Nominal rainfall, elevated topography, standard municipal drainage outfall.
Elevated monsoon accumulation; local street waterlogging likely in low-lying depressions.
High accumulation (>115mm) or proximity to tidal river backwater; significant locality inundation probability.
Extreme precipitation or confluence of heavy rainfall with tidal gate lockage; widespread locality flood expected.

scientific_limitations: Locality-level resolution: Predicts 24-hour flood occurrence for municipal wards, not building-level water depth or flow velocity.
Sample size constraint: Verified historical dataset contains 10 events (6 flood events, 4 controls) across 10 wards (N=100 observations).
Astronomical coastal tide gauge telemetry and storm drain SCADA water levels are uninstrumented in real-time.
